latest.headline: MU up about 3% pre-market after Monday's 5.8% drop; AMD reports tonight
latest.tldr: Monday's chip bounce failed, MU closed at $833.59 (−5.78%) and Seoul and Taipei each fell 3.6% overnight. MU is still indicated about 2–3% higher near $850–$860 on a flat-to-firm Nasdaq, but tonight's AMD, Arista and Super Micro results and the election make this open easy to fade, as Monday's was.
